messages:
anya: Heads-up — pen-test planning thread. We need to lock the RBAC change window and confirm KMS proxy workflow before the assessor starts. Can we pick a 2h window this Friday?
kevin: Friday 10–12 PT looks good for infra changes. Is that the window you mean?
anya: Yes. 10:00–12:00 PT. Primary goals: 1) temporary role creation & scope, 2) audit log exports enabled, 3) KMS proxy for read-only decrypt during evidence capture.
liam: Quick Q on KMS proxy: will the assessor need direct decrypt or just signed access to logs? direct decrypt is riskier.
maria: Assessor needs to validate encrypted artifacts. We prefer read-only decrypt via proxy that logs every call. No long-lived keys.
kevin: Ok. Plan: create ephemeral role with session duration 1h, limited to assessor principal. Proxy will be a short-lived service session initiated by ops.
anya: Can we draft the minimal IAM policy? Something like:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:DescribeKey"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/xxxx","Condition":{"DateLessThan":{"aws:EpochTime":1767779999}}}
  ]
}
```
kevin: That looks fine but add a condition on "aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent": true for interactive sessions. Also restrict source IPs to the office jump host for the proxy.
liam: For audit logging, enable continuous export to secure S3 bucket with object lock for 30 days. We should snapshot the audit trail before the window and after.
maria: Agree. Also include a short checklist for remediation triage: vuln ticket, owner, patch plan, test evidence, retest slot requests. We'll need ticket IDs in the evidence pack.
anya: How do we hand off evidence to the assessor? Presigned S3 links or readroom? Presigned links with 24h TTL seems easiest.
kevin: Use presigned links but require the assessor to connect via the proxy's IP allowlist. We'll generate links from the audit bucket and log access.
pt-bot: Reminder: PenTest intake form submitted by acme-assessors. Estimated start: 2026-03-27. Use channel #eng-security for all assessor comms.
maria: Retest cadence — we should plan two retest slots: one for quick fixes (48–72h) and one for regression validation (2 weeks). We need to communicate that to Product owners.
liam: I'll schedule the RBAC role creation and proxy deploy in staging tomorrow, then promote to prod in the Friday window.
kevin: I'll prepare the IAM policy and the presigned link generator script. Pushing PR to infra repo with runbook steps.
anya: Thanks. Action items:
- liam: stage deploy proxy + snapshot audit (due: tomorrow)
- kevin: PR with IAM policy + presigned generator (due: EOD today)
- maria: draft remediation triage template and retest SLAs (due: EOD tomorrow)
- anya: coordinate assessor and confirm retest slots (due: EOD today)
kevin: tagging infra-schedule and sec-ops.
maria: If anything blocks, ping me and I’ll escalate to SOC ops. :+1:
anya: Will post the final runbook here once PRs are green. Thanks everyone.
